text:
amelia.sales: quick sync — ACME POC can't finish onboarding. SCIM push from Okta returns 204 but users don't show up in the tenant UI. SAML assertion looks like it's sending a session id in NameID, not an email or username. also they need a hosted API key to run a Dedicated pool throughput test. cc @noah.eng @sam.se
noah.eng: which idp? can you paste the SAML attr snippet they configured?
amelia.sales: they're on Okta. here's the relevant bits they pasted (redacted):
```xml
<Subject>
  <NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified\">_session_12345</NameID>
</Subject>
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name=\"email\">
    <AttributeValue>user@example.com</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"groups\">
    <AttributeValue>engineers</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```
sam.se: Okta often sets NameID to a session id by default. For our provisioning we expect either NameID=email or a `preferred_username`/`userName` claim. SCIM 204 just means Okta accepted our endpoint response; it doesn't guarantee the user was assigned to the target group. Are they using group push or Just-In-Time?
amelia.sales: they're using group push to the SCIM endpoint. Okta admin says SCIM shows 204 on push but our logs show a 403 for the initial call. i asked for screenshots. tenant id is `acme-poc-2026`.
charlie.ops: 403 from our SCIM endpoint means auth failed — likely token mismatch or wrong header. For Dedicated tests we issue a separate SCIM service token (different from hosted-api key). Amelia, did we share the SCIM secret with them or the standard API key?
amelia.sales: i confirmed we gave them the token from the initial sales packet (looks like a hosted api key). they assumed it's valid for SCIM.
noah.eng: that's the issue. SCIM should use the SCIM token we provisioned (scim_token_***). Hosted API keys are not accepted at /scim/v2. two action items: 1) ask them to swap the Bearer token in Okta to the SCIM token we provide; 2) update SAML NameID to email or map `userName` to `profile.login`. sample Okta mapping:
```json
{
  \"SAML NameID\": \"user.email\",
  \"SCIM userName\": \"profile.login\"
}
```
linda.sec: small security note: for Private/VPC customers we require SCIM traffic to come from a fixed IP range or via a proxy with mTLS depending on the contract. If ACME is running behind an outbound proxy that rewrites headers we'll hit auth failures. also ensure TLS termination isn't happening before the token check.
amelia.sales: i've requested a screenshot of the Okta SCIM config and the raw request headers. they also asked if we can temporarily create a hosted API key to let them run the Dedicated pool latency/cost tests while they fix SCIM.
charlie.ops: i can create a short-lived, scoped key for tenant `acme-poc-2026` with explicit scopes: [\"inference:generate\",\"tenant:read\"], expires in 72h. it will only allow access to the `dedicated-test` pool and a test model. will that unblock them?
amelia.sales: yes that would unblock the perf runs. please add an annotation that we rotate it on expiry. :thumbsup:
idp-bot: SCIM webhook from okta.acme.example.com -> /scim/v2/users returned 403 at 1763801400 (token mismatch)
noah.eng: once they swap the token and set NameID to email we'll re-check. if group push still fails, run this curl from their network to reproduce: 
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer SCIM_TOKEN_GOES_HERE\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/scim+json\" 
  https://scim-redwood.example.com/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
```
amelia.sales: noted. sharing the short-lived key now and asking Okta admin to change NameID to EmailAddress + verify group push. will follow up with screenshots. thanks all.
charlie.ops: temp key created: key_id=tmp_acme_72h, expires=1764070430, scopes=[inference:generate,tenant:read], allowed_models=[gptx-test] — i'll DM the secret to Amelia. :lock:
amelia.sales: received, handing off to ACME. I'll loop back when they confirm SCIM push shows 200 and users appear.
noah.eng: if they need a SAML metadata file or example Okta steps i can paste quick instructions.
amelia.sales: pls do if they ping. ending thread for now. :sparkles:
